audited_identity_tail_prefix.serialization: Each operation7 little-endian u64:kind,control2,control1,target,c_target,c_condition,r_target. Kind padding is zero. Same56-byte records as protected QECCOPSZ payload.

statement: For each fixed original ABI input x and scored coordinate bit b, audited equivalence is G_b(x,s)=F_b(x,pi(s)) for every candidate MR vector s. If a separate sound source-bound certificate proves F_b(x,r) constant for every original MR vector r for this x,b, then G_b(x,s)=F_b(x,0) for every s. This per-input premise does not require global MR independence.
separate_premises: The mask certifies every original MR assignment for this exact input and bit, and is bound to original4b stream hash.
The value evaluator exactly computes the original source function with all original MR bits zero.
The expected curve output and every evaluated input derive from the final candidate own Fiat preparation, including its final nonce.
safe_rejection: A certified masked-bit mismatch to the correct reference curve value proves failure on this input regardless of candidate MR. Uncertified bits, matching bits and empty masks do not prove a full pass.
nonce_scope: A nonce change must preserve the audited pre-tail operations byte for byte, followed by48 adjacent XX identity pairs. Validate these exact bytes/shape and use the final candidate own Fiat inputs. Never reuse a packet belonging to another source.
remaining_validation: Full exact simulator handles survivors, including every unproved bit, phase and dirty scratch; unchanged official benchmark remains required.
does_not_certify: any arithmetic precision repair changing F
